test_details.name: test_outbox_repository_instantiation_with_session_factory
test_details.outcome: SqlOutboxRepository instantiated with session_factory (Publisher loop mode) executes fetch/update in clean short-lived sessions without attribute errors.

test_details.name: test_outbox_repository_instantiation_with_session
test_details.outcome: SqlOutboxRepository instantiated with AsyncSession (UOW mode) participates in active session.

test_details.name: test_transactional_append_commits_both_records
test_details.outcome: Domain entity and outbox event are saved and committed atomically in the same database transaction.

test_details.name: test_transactional_append_rollback_leaves_zero_records
test_details.outcome: Transaction rollback leaves zero records in both domain and outbox SQL tables.

test_details.name: test_get_pending_filters_by_available_at
test_details.outcome: get_pending correctly filters pending records where available_at <= now.

test_details.name: test_mark_published_and_mark_failed
test_details.outcome: mark_published and mark_failed accurately update status, attempt_count, and last_error in SQL.
